The Block estimated about $2 million in attacker proceeds and separately valued later withdrawals of 53.7 million ACE from bridge reserves at about $3.7 million. Review mint privileges and recent changes, suspend compromised permissions, and alert on abnormal mint volumes and discrepancies between minted supply and reserves.
Before restoring the bridge, reconcile supply against reserves and validate recovery controls and mint limits.

Monitor bank and card activity and contact your provider through a verified number about unfamiliar transactions.
Preserve access and export logs, verify the scope of data access in each service, and reconcile notified users before reporting a distinct-person total.
